campaign_brief.objective: To introduce the Electric Unicycle KingSong 14D as a versatile, dependable, and fun personal electric mobility solution for urban commuters and trail explorers in India.
campaign_brief.key_message: The Radboards KingSong 14D is built for navigating city streets and exploring trails, offering a reliable, fun ride that fits into your life.

proof_points.claim: Experience versatile handling with a 14-inch tyre for excellent maneuverability.
proof_points.source: The Kingsong 14D has a 14-inch tire that provides excellent maneuverability and portability.

proof_points.claim: Cover up to 40 km on a single charge, perfect for daily commutes or longer rides.
Reach destinations faster with speeds up to 30 km/h, powered by an 800W motor.
At 14.5 kg, the KingSong 14D is easy to carry up to your flat or office.

campaign_brief.success_metric: Increase in product page views for the KingSong 14D on radboards.in by 20% in the first month.

caption:
Navigate your commute or trails with the KingSong 14D. Your next ride. 🛣️
Built for real Indian streets, this electric unicycle packs an 800W motor and a 14-inch tyre for easy handling. Glide up to 40 km on a single charge. Reach speeds of 30 km/h. At 14.5 kg, it's easy to carry or store.
Ready for a dependable, fun way to move? Get yours today!
₹75,000. Range & speed vary.
